localChanges: fix: a Wonder only goes obsolete once, however many civilizations later discover its advance

log: `Obsolete` was processed every time another player discovered the obsoleting advance. A new `notDiscoveredByAnyOtherPlayer` criterion matches only the first discovery, the moment `notDiscoveredByAnyPlayer` stops holding.
It failed with 4 trade where it expected 6 (civ-clone/web-renderer#22). The Colossus rule was right; the test was not.

The default `WorkedTileRegistry` asks the default rule registry whether a tile can be worked, and that never sees `setUpCity`'s `CanBeWorked` rule. Growing the city picked tiles already worked: run alone the test threw "Tile 0, 0 is already worked!", and in the suite the result depended on which tests ran before.
A city works its own tile and a first worker through `civ1-city`'s `Created` rules, since that moved out of `City`. The test never registered them, so a size-5 city worked 4 tiles, not 6.

Node 12 and actions v1 no longer install this project's dependencies, and yarn cannot install mocha 10 on Node 12 (civ-clone/web-renderer#66). CI installs with pnpm as web-renderer does, because npm cascades through the github: dependencies.
prettier:check had no --check, so it printed the formatted source and passed whatever it found.
ts-mocha 9 only accepts mocha up to 9, and npm refuses the mocha 10 this package asks for.
